title: 2011 AMC 8 Problem 11
statement: The graph shows the number of minutes studied by both Asha (left bar) and Sasha (right bar) in one week. On the average, how many more minutes per day did Sasha study than Asha?

solutions.text:
We can calculate the difference in average minutes by looking at the differences per day.

Starting with Monday, the differences between Sasha and Asha are \(10,\) \(-10,\) \(20,\) \(30,\) and \(-20.\) This is a total of \(30\) minutes. Therefore, the average difference is \(30 \div 5 = 6.\)

Thus, A is the correct answer.
hints: Average the five daily differences instead of averaging each person separately.
Compare Sasha and Asha day by day.
